description: Share Wi-Fi to Ethernet, or Ethernet to a Wi-Fi hotspot

store.summary: TNT WiFi Share: Wi-Fi to Ethernet, hotspot and guest Wi-Fi login
store.description: Part of TNT (Tech Nomad Ted) tools, TheTechNomad.com. Gets a standalone AV rack online from the CardputerZero: share Wi-Fi internet to the Ethernet port (NAT, with a DHCP server you can turn off for static networks), or turn a wired connection into a small Wi-Fi hotspot. Join Wi-Fi, log in to guest Wi-Fi pages (simple ones on the built-in screen, others in a browser on HDMI) and set every address from the keyboard. Status shows uplink, SSID, IPs and connected devices. Quitting restores your normal network.
